name: elementcolors-simple
description: Simple ladder for the elementColors flag (tier:'simple' — shown in both Simple and Pro by default): select a wall in the 2D plan editor, verify the 'Wall colour' picker renders in WallInspector, drive a real colour change through the store, confirm the swatch trigger reflects it, then prove the flag directly gates the row (setFeatureFlag false hides it, true restores it).

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: select-first-wall
steps.eval: (function(){ const w = window.__store.getState().floorPlan.walls[0]; if (!w) throw new Error('no walls in default plan'); window.__wallId = w.id; window.__store.getState().setPlanSelection({ type: 'wall', id: w.id }); })()

steps.name: verify-wall-colour-row-present-simple
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = document.querySelector('button[aria-label="Wall colour"]'); if (!btn) throw new Error('Wall colour picker not found in .plan-props — elementColors row missing even though flag is tier:simple (default on)'); })()

steps.name: verify-swatch-reflects-colour
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = document.querySelector('button[aria-label="Wall colour"]'); const bg = getComputedStyle(btn).backgroundColor; if (bg !== 'rgb(51, 102, 204)') throw new Error('Wall colour trigger did not reflect the applied colour, got: ' + bg); })()

steps.name: verify-reset-button-present
steps.eval: (function(){ const btns = [...document.querySelectorAll('.plan-props button')]; const reset = btns.find(b => b.textContent.trim() === 'reset'); if (!reset) throw new Error('reset link missing after a colour override was set'); })()

steps.name: verify-wall-colour-row-present-pro
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = document.querySelector('button[aria-label="Wall colour"]'); if (!btn) throw new Error('Wall colour row missing in Pro mode'); })()

steps.name: verify-wall-colour-row-hidden
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = document.querySelector('button[aria-label="Wall colour"]'); if (btn) throw new Error('Wall colour row still present after setFeatureFlag(elementColors,false)'); })()

steps.name: verify-wall-colour-row-restored
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = document.querySelector('button[aria-label="Wall colour"]'); if (!btn) throw new Error('Wall colour row did not come back after restoring the flag'); })()
